item.title: Expand cmd-groom module with remaining groom helpers from main
item.intent: Move _build_groom_context, protect_items_from_groom, snapshot_backlogs, enforce_groom_limits, print_groom_diff, and run_groom_flow out of .aishore/aishore and into the existing .aishore/lib/cmd-groom.sh — all groom logic lives in one module, ~150 lines removed from main, bash -n passes on both files.
steps: Identify the six groom helper functions remaining in .aishore/aishore: _build_groom_context, protect_items_from_groom, snapshot_backlogs, enforce_groom_limits, print_groom_diff, run_groom_flow
Append the six functions to .aishore/lib/cmd-groom.sh in the same order they appear in the main script
Confirm dispatch table already loads cmd-groom before invocation — no dispatch change needed if _load_module cmd-groom is already wired
Run bash -n on both files to verify syntax
Run .aishore/aishore groom --backlog (dry-run context only) to confirm the groom flow is still reachable
acceptanceCriteria: .aishore/aishore groom --backlog runs without error (agent invocation is expected)
wc -l .aishore/aishore shows at least 130 fewer lines than before this change
All six groom helper functions are absent from .aishore/aishore and present in cmd-groom.sh
